item.title: MOLDRISE
item.description:
Title: MOLDRISE
Genre: Adventure , Indie
Developer: Raffaele Picca
Publisher: Raffaele Picca
Release Date: Jul 20, 2026




About This Game

It started in your foot. Now it’s in your head.

The only thought left is: GO UP .

The building has thirty floors. Your body has problems - hunger, thirst, exhaustion. The infection doesn’t care. It only wants altitude.

The foot keeps climbing. The rest of you is just trying to keep up.

Meet your Neighbors.

The building is not haunted. The people in it are not monsters - and they want things. Junk. Food. Favors. Someone to do something mildly humiliating to their neighbor.

A few of them know things they shouldn't. None of them know they're describing the same thing.

You're the only one collecting the pieces.

Learn. Adapt. Climb.

The building is the same every time you climb it. The neighbors are the same. The trades are the same. The vending machine on the ground floor has the same stock.

What changes is what you know.

Every run, you learn something. A shortcut. A better trade. An item you didn't know mattered until the floor you needed it on. The building slowly starts to make sense.

And again.

You’ll know what to do next time.

But your foot isn’t waiting.

First-person survival horror. Retro aesthetics. A thirty-floor apartment building with no empty floors and no happy endings.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Body horror through sound and implication.



System Requirements

Windows

Linux

item.title: Bookshop Simulator
item.description:
Title: Bookshop Simulator
Genre: Action , Adventure , RPG , Simulation , Sports
Developer: Blep Games
Publisher: Blep Games
Release Date: Jul 20, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 16, 2025




About This Game

Fulfill your dream of owning and operating your own bookshop. Buy and sell inventory and use the profits to decorate and expand your shop. Build your business from a small boutique shop into a retail empire!

Buy and place bookshelves, then fill them with new books, comics, board games, and other items to sell. Run the cash register to earn revenue. As your business grows, hire employees to be cashiers and item stockers so you can focus on expansion.

Expand your reach to new locations around the world. Use your income from established shops to help set up new shops. Travel between shops to manage them and optimize your profits. Early access will launch with the France and Japan locations.

Use your profits to customize your store. Choose walls and floors. Decorate with rugs, plants, wall art, and more! Create specialized sections for your favorite genre, or build cozy book nooks.

Get boxes of used books that may contain rare mythical books. These books have powerful abilities to improve your profits and capabilities.

Adopt a cat to keep you and your customers company every day in the shop. Buy food, a bed, and other items to keep the cat active and happy in the store.

    • Processor: Intel i7 9700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 1070 / Vega 56
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 10 GB available space

item.title: Foghorns Drown
item.description:
Title: Foghorns Drown
Genre: Indie
Developer: Studio Laaya
Publisher: Studio Laaya
Release Date: Jul 20, 2026




About This Game

The chain is stubborn. The fog is restless. The air smells like tar.

The foghorns wake you, violent as ever. Another passenger has come to cross the fog.

In the dream you wander through the pines, and come upon a body. Innocent and young, murdered in cold blood. By your hand or another? Makes no difference now.

Foghorns Drown is a short psychological thriller, inspired by Silent Hill, Twin Peaks, and Mouthwashing. You play as a ferryman, bringing passengers across a foggy lake to a town drenched in mystery and folklore. The old ferryman has disappeared, and a murder has been committed.

How to tell real from dream when the dead speak again?

Features:

  • Physics-based interactions to open doors, drag objects, and operate the crank of the ferry to pull it along a rusty old chain. The foghorns have little patience, the ferry must move.

  • A rich, detailed narrative told through environmental clues, dialogue with the townsfolk, and surreal visions woven into your experience. The fog speaks to those who listen.

  • Psychological horror that escalate as truth begins to blur, and strange old tales begin to reveal themselves to you. Something in the water demands its toll.

  • Who is the killer? Why did the old ferryman disappear? Solve the mystery, before it's too late.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: General Mature Content



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 / 11
    • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual core or better
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750ti or better
    • Storage: 5 GB available space

item.title: ZeroSpace
item.description:
Title: ZeroSpace
Genre: Action , Indie , Massively Multiplayer , RPG , Simulation , Strategy , Early Access
Developer: Starlance Studios , Ironward
Publisher: Starlance Studios , Gamersky Games
Franchise: Mastermind Strategies , RTS Fest Friends
Release Date: Jul 20, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Jul 20, 2026




About This Game

ZeroSpace is a hybrid sci-fi RTS / RPG game that allows you to play as the commander of The Protectorate, a galactic force dedicated to securing humanity’s place in the galaxy. The Orion sector is locked in a vicious power struggle between many alien factions, all armed to the teeth and ready to fight to the death to achieve space dominance. Harness the latest warfare technology and recruit seasoned shock troopers and specialist crew members. Navigate through political turmoil as you make the hard choices needed to guarantee humanity’s place among the stars. But really the choice is yours. Don’t like the Protectorate? Pick a different faction, and wipe your opposition off the face of the galaxy.

Wage Intense, massive scale conflict

Deploy infantry, artillery and air weaponry to dominate the battlefield. Engage in strategic buildcraft and troop deployment either solo, with a friend or against everyone. Orbital weapons, nuclear strikes, mechs are just some of the ingredients you get to play with. Pick your favorite arsenal and allegiance and lay waste to your enemies, scattering their burning carcasses among the Orion Sector.

You are the last line of defense

Jump into an epic, cinematic saga of brotherhood in arms that spans the galaxy. Take on the mantle of Aster, Commander of the Protectorate, tasked with saving humanity from losing access to interstellar travel and receding into an age of darkness and ignorance. Engage in a cinematic RPG experience where your choices shape the future of the galaxy, then drop into the battlefields to execute on your strategies.

Choose your allegiance & arsenal

With 4 warring factions (3 active in pre-launch period), 7 mercenary factions and 14 distinct commanders all vying for power and dominance, you will have to use all your wit and strategic thinking to come out on top. Ally yourself with the right parties, build out your force, and protect the Orion sector.

PROTECTORATE

A Caelo Ad Terram.

For centuries the Protectorate have been the stalwart defenders of humanity’s ventures through the Orion Arm, guarding against enemies foreign and domestic of the United Earth Spheres. As humanity’s galactic infrastructure teeters on the brink of collapse over a deficit of the resource “flux,” the Protectorate brings honed tactics and heavy firepower to bear. Field veteran commandos to deep strike enemy positions, or bring the heavy firepower of your mech divisions to break enemy lines.

GRELL

Grow. Expand. Exterminate.

The Grell are a tide of highly evolved plant-like creatures that spawn sites of raw flux crystals through the galaxy, and humanity’s first contact with alien life. As external powers dive deeper into exploiting flux for faster than light travel, the once passive Grell have begun to flood across worlds, wiping out those who would threaten their biosphere. Expand your blooms by spreading the roots of your biomass across the battlefield, and rip apart your enemies with twisted evolutions from the acidic Harbinger to the rampaging Reaver.

LEGION

Across a Million Worlds, We March.

The Legion of Truth are a fanatical empire from beyond the reaches of known space, devoted to their Emperor and a pantheon of god-like beings. Their armies crusade across the cosmos, bringing all in their path under the Idals, and purging those unwilling or unable to accept the voice. Drown your enemies with waves of expendable Thralls and Fanatics, and break your enemy under the treads of the titanic Terror Tank, a mobile fortress that can reconfigure with the tide of battle.

XOL

For Purpose. For Survival.

The Xol are civilization of autonomous robotic consciousness, brought to the brink of extinction by the dark crusade of the Legion. Though fiercely individualistic, they are united by one imperative: survival. As the tide of annihilation turns against them, the Xol will bring the most advanced robotics technology in the galaxy to bear, wield the accumulated genius of their society, and wipe out all who threaten their future.

Join a persistent, shared galactic war

Rank to become the dominant battle group in the sector as you take part in a living, breathing galaxy shared by thousands of real players. Defend your territory and conquer neighboring planets by leading a vast armada of troops, aliens, creatures, vehicles, and heavy weaponry- all for the glory of your alliance.

Enjoy Classic RTS combat, evolved

Building on decades of RTS mechanics, enjoy a unit management and control system that is both streamlined and deep, allowing for smooth control at all levels of play. Are you a fan of micromanaging every unit type or do you just love the big ball of death? Zerospace makes it easy for you to manage your armies and conflict. Play your way with several gameplay modes: Solo, Co-op, Co-op /w AI, PVP, etc.

Feature & content breakdown:

  • A singleplayer campaign with 15 main story missions, 10 hero loyalty missions, and 15 side story arc missions. With choices and dialog trees similar to Mass Effect and Baldur's Gate.

  • Hours of cinematic cutscenes and interactive dialogs where your choices dictate the game’s outcome.

  • 10 specialist heroes from various factions in campaign mode to build relationships with, or select from over 14 to lead your multiplayer games.

  • A separate, persistent Galaxy map with multiple game modes that contribute towards shared conquest. (Co-op, Single-player, PvE, 2vAI, 2v2, Scenarios and 1v1)

  • 4 main factions - From a plant species to organic robots.

  • 7 mercenary factions - Delivering even more specialized battle groups

Wishlist & Follow today!



Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Provides a top-down representation of warfare, depicting non-realistic science fiction battles.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: AMD / Intel CPU, 4 Cores 3 Ghz
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia 1080 Ti or RX 5700
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 50 GB available space
    • Sound Card: NVIDIA High Definition Audio
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: AMD / Intel CPU, 8 Cores 3 Ghz
    • Graphics: RTX 3060Ti or RX 6800
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 50 GB available space
    • Sound Card: NVIDIA High Definition Audio

item.title: G-Rebels
item.description:
Title: G-Rebels
Genre: Action , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: Reakktor Studios
Publisher: Senatis
Release Date: Jul 20, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Jul 20, 2026




About This Game

G-Rebels: An action-packed combat flight sim in a dystopian open world full of intrigue, free exploration, dangerous missions and breathtaking flight maneuvers.

In the year 2684, Earth was almost completely flooded by catastrophic events. The survivors created floating megacities, which compete for the remaining natural resources.

As part of an elite unit of the most powerful city-state, it is your job to ensure law and order in the metropolis and the colonies.

With your ultra-modern glider, you secure transport routes and fight organized crime. But the course of a secret mission suddenly calls everything into question: are you fighting for the right side or are you part of a dark conspiracy?

  • Discover vibrant metropolises, outposts, research facilities, factories, etc. in a freely explorable world of more than 12,000 square kilometers.

  • Follow the main storyline or discover the world on your own and earn your money in mining, as a bounty hunter, racing pilot, bodyguard, mercenary, pirate or as a hunter for lost artifacts.

  • Invest the credits you earn in upgrading your Skyblade: Engine, weapon or shield upgrades? AI-controlled drones, multi-warhead missiles or stealth devices? Plan your Skyblade's equipment before you go into battle.

  • Fight against other gliders or hack into their control unit to take control of enemy skyblades.

  • Take part in the battle for power: conquer outposts, skyports, power plants, etc. to help your faction gain influence and control.

  • Technical and visual highlights: Changing weather conditions with volumetric clouds, dynamic sun and moon position with realistic day-night changes, complete world streaming (no loading screens), real-time simulation of thousands of flying objects in the world, etc.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Some dialogues feature AI-generated voices. Parts of the marketing assets - including store texts other than english or german- are modified / localized with AI.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 or higher
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 1070 or AMD RX 5700 XT with at least 8 GB VRAM
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 30 GB available space
    • VR Support: OpenXR, tested with Meta Quest 2 & 3 and HTC Vive
    • Additional Notes: optional VR Support (PC-VR), VR Controller not supported
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 or higher
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-14700K or AMD Ryzen 9 7900X
    • Memory: 32 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 4080 or AMD RX 7900 XT with at least 12 GB VRAM
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 30 GB available space
    • VR Support: OpenXR, tested with Meta Quest 2 & 3 and HTC Vive
    • Additional Notes: optional VR Support (PC-VR), VR Controller not supported
